blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac appealed for additional funding for 2027, citing ongoing global tensions and the need to prepare for their potential impact on overseas Filipino workers (OFWs). Cacdac made the appeal during the DMW and Overseas Workers Welfare Administration’s (OWWA) budget hearing before the Senate finance subcommittee. “I don’t want to name any other countries but the political insecurity projections are not entirely optimistic to say the least, so we have to be ready and not just for the Middle East,” Cacdac told Sen.
